_config: config/kaggle_tt7_decoy_b.yaml with --set segment.max_segment_duration_sec=1.0 --set vlm.enabled=true --set vlm.backend=GEMINI --set vlm.model_name=gemini-3.1-flash-lite
_why: This is the run that reproduced the OPEN-for-CLOSE inversion for the fourth
time, and it is the baseline the state-contradiction fix is measured against.
It scored: 2 EXACT, 2 REVERSED, 3 OTHER; 7/7 WITHIN_TOL; 3/7 unambiguous.
The inversion is not a phrasing problem. All three OPEN answers describe the
transition progressively -- 'flaps are being unfolded', 'flap is being
lifted' -- so there is no closed-word inside any one answer to contradict
the verb. The contradiction is only visible ACROSS observations: the model
itself calls the box 'an open cardboard box' at 0.0s, and a box that is
already open cannot be opened three more times.
Ground truth for this stretch is FOLD 2.0-3.0 then CLOSE 3.0-4.0.

verbatim: segment_start_sec / segment_end_sec are the seven 0.952s windows the run
